name: Catherine Vautrin
bio: Catherine Vautrin, born 26 July 1960 in Reims, is a French politician who has served as Minister of the Armed Forces and Veterans since October 2025, a position she retained in Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu's government following the 26 February 2026 reshuffle. A former RPR, UMP and Les Républicains figure who later aligned with the presidential majority, she previously held the combined Labour, Health, Solidarity and Families portfolio (2024-2025) and the Partnership with Territories and Decentralisation portfolio (2024). She was a member of the National Assembly for Marne's 2nd constituency, a vice-president of the Assemblée nationale, and president of Grand Reims from 2014 to 2024.
